// A named blend-shape: per-vertex position and normal deltas added to the base
// mesh, scaled by the target's weight. Both delta arrays are parallel to the
// mesh's vertices; an empty NormalDeltas array means "positions only".
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morph_target_animation)
type MorphTarget
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    PositionDeltas: Array<Vector3D>;
    NormalDeltas: Array<Vector3D>;
}
